top_signals.title: Colombia Coffee Exports Partially Resume After Quake
top_signals.summary: Colombia partially resumed coffee exports through Buenaventura port, on the country’s the Pacific coast, after the earthquake, according to the Gustavo Gómez, head of the country’s coffee exporters association, Asoexport.
